check:integration.comparison: Reviewed frozen engines/integration.py, analysis/_integration.py, application/integration.py, adapters/providers/integration.py and languages/integration.py in full. The frozen legacy oracle golden is replayed through native `ici verify`: exit code, engine status/summary/required/evidence, all targets, the per-case table (assertion map, return codes, truncation flags) and all four finding fingerprints (finding_fingerprint(rule, ici.toml:1, symbol=case name) for ici.hybrid.process-contract and the adapted ici.legacy.integration.target rows), severities, confidences, messages and tool_rule_ids are identical; the projected v3 tool_evidence (per-case name, argv, returncode, stderr preview) now also gives adapted rows the frozen tool_name (including its first-evidence quirk). Deep-profile only, opt-in by declared cases; SKIP/NOT_APPLICABLE located target for empty optional scope and incomplete required-empty scope; whole-token {python:NAME}/{artifact:ID} placeholders; replace-not-merge environment (inherit_env subset + declared env); max_cases 1..32, max_output_bytes 1024..8 MiB, 64 argv tokens of <=1024 chars within 32 KiB, 32 bounded needles, python target name/value and inherit_env name bounds; timeout, truncation, signal, cancellation are incomplete process evidence rather than findings; required case FAIL vs advisory WARN; the case order no longer lets an earlier advisory WARN hide a later required FAIL (native defect fixed in execute.rs).
check:integration.difference_reason: Native never deletes declared outputs before a case (frozen _prepare_outputs unlinks stale files); it preserves user files and requires CLOCK_REALTIME_COARSE freshness against the pre-start inventory, so a stale file is a measured output assertion failure (cpp_contracts/native_validation_extra fixtures). {python:current} means the component's declared project interpreter, never ici's own runtime (frozen used sys.executable). Cases are executed independently and an incomplete case leaves the check incomplete instead of aborting later cases; invalid configuration is refused at plan time; the legacy view renders it as frozen's ERROR 'Integration:ConfigurationError' target with the frozen fingerprint. Shadow build outputs are addressed by BUILD/PATH or the frozen VARIANT:shadow:PATH (and >512-char path-<sha256>) identity of a prepared native variant; a bare shadow-relative path is not guessed. Per-aspect next findings: native case-level ids in the modern view, legacy ids in the legacy view (root 22:35 item 4). The shared ici-config argv bound counts UTF-8 bytes where frozen counts code points. Remaining verdict differences for the root: (a) frozen deep `ici verify` refuses the whole pipeline (PipelineDefinitionError, exit 1, no report) when integration is enabled and engines.build is disabled, while native runs the integration cases without the build (PASS, exit 0; golden scenario no_build); (b) legacy `ici verify` exits 3 for an incomplete suite where frozen exits 1.
